sloka: द्विविदं वानरेन्द्रं तु नगयोधिनमाहवे ।शरैरशनि सङ्काशैः स विव्याधाशनिप्रभः ।। ६.४३.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: dvividaṁ vānarendraṁ tu nagayodhinamāhave ।śarairaśani saṅkāśaiḥ sa vivyādhāśaniprabhaḥ ।। 6.43.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Dwivida whose limbs have been injured being enraged took Sala tree and killed Asaniprabha and the charioteer as well as the horses.
